title: Timatar Gosht (Beef with Tomatoes)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: Learned from the author's friend Farrukh Azfar, a physicist and serious cook, during a visit to Oxford, with minor changes. A long braise that's worth the time and better the next day.

steps.action: Blend until very smooth; set aside:
items: 8 medium flavorful tomatoes (2½ lb / 1.1 kg total), quartered
2 cu in ginger (2 × 3 × 5 cm), peeled, in about 6 pieces

steps.action: Heat in a large pot over high, 2 min:
Add and fry, stirring, about 7 min, until well browned and the released water is mostly gone:
items: 1¾ lb stewing beef (800 g), chuck or round, in 1 in (2.5 cm) cubes

steps.action: Reduce to medium-high (7/10); add and stir hard 5 min, scraping the bottom:
Add and mix; bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on medium-low (3/10) 2 hr, stirring every 20 min:
items: If it gets too dry, ½ cup water (120 ml)

steps.action: Test: a piece of meat should cut easily with the side of a fork. If not, simmer 20 min more and repeat.
Stir in; turn off heat, cover, and rest 5 min:

items: Or Masoor Daal with plain rice or bread

edits: Source gives the extra water as 4 oz (100 ml); 4 fl oz is 120 ml
